QuestInfo.name: The Old Snail
QuestInfo.0: Heard #b#p218##k in #b#m10001000##k got her hands on a strange book. What kind of book could it be? Let’s go see her.
QuestInfo.1: The book is about the #bOldest Snail#k in Maple World and its #b#t2210000##k. It looks like #p218# is interested in the snail’s shell because it makes wishes come true. #p205# is the original owner of the book; he must know something about the author. Let’s go see him.
QuestInfo.2: #p205# said that the author of #b#t4160001##k was his great-grandfather, #bAlloy#k, who was also #b#p203#’s#k grandfather.

0.0: Have you heard about the rumor of the #b#t2210000##k? It’s a special gift that can only come from the oldest snail in Maple World. Rumor has it that it can make wishes come true! Wow! I’d give anything to have one...
0.1: What? You think this rumor is a lie? It can’t be! It's here in this book! #b#t4160001##k has details about the #b#t2210000##k. It has to be true!
0.2: However, the book doesn’t describe where to find the snail. If only I had a clue on where to find the snail, I’d go for it immediately and get the #b#t2210000##k for myself. I must try to gather information...
0.3: So how about you? I'd let you in on it if you’re Interested, too. If we do get our hands on the #b#t2210000##k, I promise I will share it with you fairly. What do you think?

yes.0: First, go meet with #b#p205##k, as this book was borrowed from him. He has a vast collection of books and knows a great deal about them. I must know who wrote #b#t4160001##k. We will start our search for the snail shell with him and eventually track down the snail itself!

no.0: Hmm... not interested? How can you turn down a treasure like this? Your loss.

1.0: Hello! You look like an adventurer. How can I help you? Oh, #b#p218##k asked you to return this book to me? #p218# really shouldn’t have gone through all this trouble—it isn't far at all!
1.1: Thank you for returning this. If you’re interested in books, please come by anytime. What? You want to know about the author of #t4160001#?

yes.0: Of course I know the author! #bAlloy#k isn't just the author of that book—he's my #bgreat-grandfather#k. He was a seaman based in #b#m10000000##k who loved adventure far more than his work, and he certainly had his fair share of it.
yes.1: So you’re interested in my great-grandfather? He is somewhat famous, and people sometimes stop by to ask about him. Why don’t you visit my mother, #b#p203##k? She can tell you more.

npc.0: You don’t look like you’ve met #b#p205##k yet. Have you lost your way? #m10001000# isn’t a big town to get lost in. You’re terrible with directions, aren’t you?

item.0: An adventurer, right? First time in #m10001000#?

lost.0: Hey, wait! Don’t leave books lying around, especially if they aren’t yours! Fortunately, someone I know picked it up. What would have happened if it got lost? #b#p205##k is usually gentle, but he has zero patience for people who lose his books!
